operators.name: custom_pad3d

returns.shape: [N, C, H + pad_top + pad_bottom, W + pad_left + pad_right]

semantics: Corresponds to torch.nn.functional.pad(x, (pad_left, pad_right, pad_top, pad_bottom), mode='constant', value=value)
Only supports mode='constant' as in reference; padding fills the specified borders with the constant value
Input x may have arbitrary strides; output must be contiguous or have strides matching F.pad result (row-major contiguous for this case)
The operator must handle all N, C, H, W dimensions without assuming any specific size; grid-stride loops should be used for large H*W
No broadcasting or reduction; output element (n,c,oh,ow) equals input element (n,c,oh-pad_top, ow-pad_left) if inside original bounds, else value
All tensor data pointers must be CUDA pointers; integer parameters are int64_t in C++
Pads the 4D input tensor x of shape [200,1,1024,1024] with pad_width=(2,1,1,2) meaning left=2, right=1, top=1, bottom=2
mode is 'constant' so padded border values are set to pad_value=0
Execution device is CUDA; output tensor is on cuda:0 with dtype float32
Returns the padded tensor; no additional computation or type conversion
Output is the same object as step_001 result
